message.content: {"question":"A body of mass m and specific heat c, initially at temperature T_i, exchanges heat from a single hot reservoir (at constant temperature T_h). The body is not a reservoir, so it has a finite heat capacity, and its temperature will increase up to T_h. What is the entropy variation of the Universe (system+environment)?","options":{"A":"ΔS_U = 0","B":"ΔS_U = mc(T_h-T_i)/T_h+mcln(T_h/T_i)","C":"ΔS_U = mc(T_i-T_h)/T_h+mcln(T_i/T_h)"},"correct":"C"}
